title: What form does the Wolfsberg fallback take — dynamic questions, an optional field, or a template upload?
question: When a bank has no Wolfsberg document, is the fallback presented as dynamic in-flow questions, as an optional field offering either upload or answers, as a pop-up or page, or as a downloadable template the bank fills in and uploads? Deferred until the number and type of questions is known.

evidence.excerpt: So would it be dynamic questions, or would that part be like an optional field to either upload the document or answer the questions? It can be either way, right?
We can figure it out once we see the number of questions and type of questions.
